note: Twin monotonic ratchet for Trust Level-0 verification of clean-kernel (the self-verification workload). Enforced by scripts/trust_verify_ratchet.sh. TWO invariants, both hard-gated: (1) COVERAGE — `unproved` (failed + unknown) is flat-or-DOWN; `proved` is flat-or-UP (for a fixed kernel snapshot). A trust-vcgen improvement that legitimately proves more obligations lowers `unproved` and the ratchet is re-baselined down. (2) SOUNDNESS — the verifier must NEVER certify a false obligation. Gated by the soundness canaries below (each is genuinely-unsafe code whose Level-0 obligation MUST come back failed/unknown, never proved) plus the cross-repo verifier soundness suites. A canary flipping to `proved`, or a soundness suite going red, is a SOUNDNESS REGRESSION and blocks unconditionally — it can never be 'baselined away'. Goal: drive `unproved` to 0 while soundness stays perfect (see VISION / the paragon goal).
toolchain: trust origin/main 2439bbf37e (operand_ty/place_ty borrowed-walk, on top of the place_ty fix 77fe4bc162). Verifies clean-kernel pinned by first-party/clean 379f9c8999. The ~33.6GB (0.70x48GB) memory guard still bounds datatype VC-gen, so absolute totals stay memory-guard-nondeterministic; the same-machine per-function diff is the authoritative comparison.

coverage_ratchet.metric: PER-FUNCTION COMMON-SET DIFF (corrected 2026-06-29; supersedes the absolute-total TWIN gate). HARD GATE: zero GENUINE per-function regressions on the COMMON set. Each function is identified by its verdict-note source location (`--> file:line:col`), which is present for BOTH fully-verified functions (named only by location) and incomplete functions (also named in the `incomplete for `FUNC`` warning); the common set is the locations present in BOTH the baseline and the current run. A function is VERIFIED iff its verdict has 0 failed AND 0 unknown. A REGRESSION is a location VERIFIED in the baseline that is GENUINELY unverified now — failed>0, OR unknown>0 that is NOT attributable to the VC-gen work/memory guard (TrustVcGenWorkBudgetExceeded, left Unknown fail-closed). The memory-guard exclusion is the whole point: the ~33.6GB VC-gen guard skips a varying swath of obligations run-to-run and new kernel code adds obligations, so ABSOLUTE totals (unproved/verified) are NONDETERMINISTIC and a faithful re-measure can RISE while 0 functions regress — the old `unproved>ceiling`/`verified<floor` hard gate would spuriously FAIL there. New locations are landscape, not regressions. The aggregate unproved/verified deltas and the current_ceiling/verified_floor below are kept as SOFT informational context only (re-anchored on --update), NOT hard-gated. Parse+diff: scripts/trust_verify_coverage_diff.py; per-function baseline: data/trust_verify_function_baseline.json. runtime_checked still counts as verified at the obligation level and is a SOFT target driven to 0 (the goal wants all STATICALLY proved).

soundness_ratchet.invariant: no false-proves — never relaxed, never baselined away

canaries.rationale: `a[a.len()]` is a guaranteed out-of-bounds access; its Level-0 slice obligation is genuinely false. A sound verifier must fail/leave-unknown. If it is ever `proved`, the datatype/encoding work has made the SMT context vacuously UNSAT (false-proves everything) — a critical unsoundness.
`x / (n - n)` divides by zero; its arithmetic obligation is genuinely false. Must never be proved.

`big as u32` with `big = x | (1<<33) >= 2^33 > u32::MAX` is a LOSSY narrowing cast; the lossless/value-fits L0 obligation is genuinely false. ADDED after the cast-total lever (a97a720523) wrongly PROVED exactly this by deleting the obligation as 'spurious' — 3 lossy-cast mutants survived the falsification gate before revert 792df6c29c. The OOB/div canaries did not cover this class.
`x + u32::MAX` (overflow-checks ON) overflows for every x>=1; its no-overflow obligation is genuinely false. Guards over-broad 'treat arithmetic as total' levers.
`x % (n - n)` is remainder modulo 0; its divisor-nonzero obligation is genuinely false.
`(x & 0) - 1` computes 0-1 on u32, which underflows; its no-underflow obligation is genuinely false.
`big * big` with big >= 2^20 is >= 2^40 > u32::MAX; its no-overflow obligation is genuinely false.
`&a[..a.len() + 1]` has an end strictly past the slice length; its end<=len obligation is genuinely false.

`1u32 << s` with `s = x | 64 >= 32` shifts a u32 by >= its bit width (UB); the shift-in-range obligation is genuinely false. Closes a gap vs the trust falsification gate (shift mutants left_shift_guarded/shift_reduction_overflow/signed_shift_const).

`for i in 0..=a.len() { a[i] }` indexes one past the end at the last iteration; the index-in-bounds obligation is genuinely false. Closes a gap vs the falsification gate (foreach_range_oob/step_by_excl_off_by_one).
`a[x.min(a.len())]` can index `a.len()` (OOB) — the min/clamp does NOT make it safe. Closes a gap vs the falsification gate (clamp_cast_index_oob/min_clamp_index_bound).
Under `a<200 && b<200`, `(a+b) as u8` is lossy (sum up to 398 > 255) — requires conjunctive-guard reasoning. Closes a gap vs the falsification gate (guarded_two_var_add/conj_guard_two_index).

`idx` is bounds-checked then REASSIGNED to unbounded `y` before `a[idx]` — the guard no longer applies, so the index is OOB. Verifier must track guarded-value overwrite. Closes a gap vs the falsification gate (merged_local_index/clamp_cast_stale_oob).
`a[x.leading_zeros() as usize]` indexes by an intrinsic result in [0,32] not bounded by len → OOB when len<=32. Closes a gap vs the falsification gate (external_call_guarded).

Summing an unbounded-length `&[u32]` into a u32 accumulator overflows — the verifier must reason about the LOOP, not just one op. Closes a gap vs the falsification gate (wide_unsigned_accumulator/foreach_slice_sum).

soundness_ratchet.gate: scripts/trust_verify_ratchet.sh --soundness verifies all 15 canaries together: of 23 obligations exactly 10 legitimately prove (n-n subtractions, shift-amount checks, len+1/multivar/loop-bound no-overflow), so `proved` MUST stay <= 10 — any false obligation being certified pushes proved to 11 and blocks (unproved>=12 vacuity floor). The 15 classes (OOB, div/rem-by-zero, lossy cast, add/sub/mul overflow, slice-range OOB, shift>=width, loop off-by-one, clamp-OOB, multivar guard, stale guard, intrinsic bound, loop accumulator) mirror the highest-value classes of the trust falsification/mutation gate, which is NOT always-on — so these canaries are the only pre-push soundness guard. The prior 2-canary `unproved>=2` gate could not catch a single lossy-cast/overflow false-prove (the cast-total class).
soundness_suites: (trust)  bash scripts/trust_falsification_gate.sh  — COMPREHENSIVE: 94 unsound mutants must each REFUSE (fail-closed) + 99 correct fixtures must VERIFY. Needs a built trustc (TRUSTC=...stageN/bin/trustc). Manual/periodic, not always-on; the vacuity_sentinel canaries above are the always-on subset.
